Maya (AE): Heads-up: Riverbank (banking vertical) wants a quick POC to move from CompetitorX -> Redwood. They care about: response parity, latency, per-message cost, and security questionnaire. Can we split tasks?
Devon (ML Eng): I can own the response-diff pipeline. Need a redacted 48h prompt dump + any pre/post processing rules they apply. Also confirm whether they rely on token-level stream hooks.
Maya (AE): They do stream, yes. Peak concurrent connections ~600 during business hours. I'll request the dump and their traffic shape.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Proposed POC plan (short): 1) lightweight adapter proxy to accept CompetitorX payloads and translate -> Redwood API, 2) replay traffic at low QPS, 3) run golden test suite for behavioral diffs, 4) produce remediation/playbook. I can scaffold the proxy.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Quick adapter example:
```python
# pseudo adapter: map competitor payload to redwood v1/responses
import requests
def forward(req):
    payload = {"input": req['message'], "model": "redwood-medium", "temperature": 0}
    return requests.post("https://api.redwood.company/v1/responses", json=payload)
```
Devon (ML Eng): For parity runs set temperature=0 and top_p=1.0? I'd prefer top_p=0.0 for deterministic token picks. Also record tokenizer outputs; CompetitorX may normalize newlines differently.
Ari (Product): Note: model family mismatch will cause systematic deltas. We should include a fallback mapping table (CompetitorX-small -> redwood-medium, etc.) and annotate expected quality/latency tradeoffs.
Jordan (Security): I'll start the SQ answers. Items I need: data retention window on their side (for mapping), legal contact, and any IP allowlist requirements. Also confirm if they want logs forwarded to their SIEM.
Sam (SRE): If we replay production-shaped traffic, we should rate-limit and run on dedicated test pool to avoid affecting prod. I can provision a sandbox pool on dedicated nodes for the replay.
Maya (AE): Pricing ask: Riverbank wants per-1k-message cost projection vs CompetitorX and an estimate for a dedicated commit. @Ari can you model hosted vs dedicated, include batching benefits and quantization (INT8) savings?
Ari (Product): Yes. I need median and p95 sequence lengths from the sample. Also whether they use long context windows for some flows. I'll include three scenarios: hosted, 3-month reserved, and on-prem Private.
Devon (ML Eng): One gotcha: CompetitorX supports a "seed" param for deterministic outputs; we don't expose seed but can run internal seeded experiments and share results. Will that satisfy their parity requirements?
Maya (AE): They said determinism for A/B testing is important. We'll propose internal reproducible runs for the POC and note product limitations.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Parity comparator checklist: normalize timestamps/dates, strip user IDs, canonicalize whitespace, apply competitor post-processing step (if any), and compare token-level Levenshtein + semantic similarity (embedding cos sim).
Devon (ML Eng): Agreed. For semantic sim use our embedding model and threshold at 0.92 for pass/fail, then manual review for edge cases.
Jordan (Security): Security blocker we've seen: some banks require customer-managed KMS for all keys. Redwood Private supports BYOK via KMS. Flagging for contracts/legal.
Maya (AE): I'll loop in legal once we have their draft contract asks.
replay-bot: replay job created by Priya - job_id=9921 - estimated run 18m.
Sam (SRE): I'll spin up the sandbox pool and attach a temporary egress IP range for their allowlist.
Priya (Solutions Eng): Timeline suggestion (10 business days): Days 1-2 adapter + infra, Days 3-5 replay + capture, Days 6-7 parity analysis, Days 8-9 fixes and prompt wrappers, Day 10 deliverables + pricing.
Ari (Product): Also include a sensitivity table: latency vs batching window (20ms, 50ms, 200ms) and expected cost per 1k messages. That helps procurement decide.
Maya (AE): Next steps: 1) Riverbank to upload sample + SQ, 2) Priya start adapter + replay, 3) Sam to provision sandbox, 4) Jordan start SQ draft, 5) Ari + Devon to run parity & cost model. Sync in 7 business days. Please ack. :eyes:
